name: stage_handtuned_proto_steps_v1_gaitcycle_v4
description: v4 of the gait-cycle A/B — adds limit-cycle continuity gate. v3 finding: 7 sparsely-distributed good cycles in 45 min produced moderate destabilization without sustained gait, because a single 4-foot cycle is easy to fake via a forward lurch (Pattern E from registry). v4 keeps v3's adaptive thresholds (so the progress/wobble bars track the body's own dynamics) but additionally requires N consecutive good cycles before any pulse fires, with the streak resetting to 0 on ANY abort (wobble/timeout/low_progress). Same-direction is implicit (all good cycles have progress in the active walk_v direction). Pulse fires every good cycle once streak >= N — sustained gait pays continuously, falling out stops the pay. N=2 chosen as a 'meaningful but reachable' first test: in v3 baseline the rate of consecutive-2 streaks was probably near zero (7 good / 820 attempts, sparsely distributed), so even N=2 is a strong continuity demand. If v4 shows pulse activity, N=3 is the strict limit-cycle test for v5. If v4 shows zero pulses, mechanism is falsified — pivot per Pattern E discussion.
